newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Concord Land shares end debut at HK$3.40.
newsitem.headline: Concord Land shares end debut at HK$3.40.

text.p: Shares of property developer Concord Land Development Co Ltd closed at HK$3.40 each on their market debut on Thursday, below their issue price of HK$3.48.
"The stock had been expected to fall below its issue price," said Priscilla Ng, executive director at CEF GC Brokerage.
"Its fundamentals are not so good and its share subscription rate was low," she said.

The Hong Kong and China property division of Pacific Concord Holdings Ltd offered 300 million shares at HK$3.48 per share, of which 85 percent was placed with institutional investors and 15 percent was offered in Hong Kong.
The local initial public offer was 1.53 times subscribed.
Brokers said the stock's lacklustre fundamentals and competition from other new listings resulted in poor price performance on Thursday.
"There are many choices for investors," said Ben Kwong, director at Dharmala Securities. "There are several new listings this week."
China property firm China Resources Beijing Land Ltd and eye glass frame maker Arts Optical International Holdings Ltd start trading on Friday.

"Fundamentals also count. In the near future, its property contribution will come mainly from Hong Kong while its China operation is still at an investment stage and can't been expected to generate much return yet," Kwong added.
The share chalked up a price of HK$3.60 at opening trade, but then quickly retreated to HK$3.275.
